analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 43.1 in neutral territory, MACD histogram worsening to -3.9826. Volume ratio at 1.40x average indicates increased activity but lacks directional conviction. Current price at 42.2% of 52-week range. 5-day range $386.90/$318.48, 20-day range $440.88/$318.48. Price near swing support at $360.55. ATR at 6.21% signals ongoing volatility. Weekly ADX at 32.8 suggests a trend, but daily MACD deterioration and neutral RSI prevent confirmation of trend reversal. 4H RSI at 44.9 and MACD histogram at -1.5619 show continued weakness. Quantitative buy attractiveness at 42/100, sell pressure at 17/100. Overall, insufficient grounds for a buy signal, maintaining risk management posture.
